name: Vimta Labs Ltd
title: Vimta Labs Ltd-$ - 524394 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Vimta's Q4 FY26 revenue rose 16.6% YoY to INR1,120m with 37.6% EBITDA margin, but management gave no capacity or capex discipline signals and flagged utilisation ramp, war-related cost pressure and weaker electronics.

utilisation.quote: Utilization will slowly pick up because you don't build a facility wherein you're going to occupy it immediately.

triggers.label: New facility utilisation still ramping
triggers.quote: utilization will pick up this year a little more next year, more the following year

triggers.label: Margin correction of 1-2% guided
triggers.quote: you can expect a correction of 1%, 2% depending on how things are panning out right now

triggers.label: Electronics weak, leadership fixed
triggers.quote: Last year for us has not been very exciting in this segment

triggers.label: Biologics CRO entry, no clients signed
triggers.quote: We have good inquiries and we will be closing them soon

guidance.value: Sustain in stable and competitive range; correction of 1-2%
guidance.quote: you can expect a correction of 1%, 2% depending on how things are panning out right now

guidance.value: 20-25% CAGR target described as stretch but doable
guidance.quote: It's a stretch number, but definitely doable. And that's what we target each year.

guidance.value: Around current region, a percent or few percent here and there
guidance.quote: we think the margins should be around this region

prior_guidance_check.quote: we said we will try and get to those run rates by Q4. But again, Q4 some headwinds in terms of external factors

red_flags.label: Missed INR500cr run-rate target
red_flags.quote: some things did not happen for us which we were expecting

red_flags.label: Geopolitical input cost and lead-time pressure
red_flags.quote: The cost of some input materials, consumables has gone up slightly. There is a slightly longer lead time

evasions.quote: We don't differentiate the margins between our service lines.
As of now, there are no firmed-up thoughts on what we will do with this money
